#include <iostream>
#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353LL;

long long power(long long base, long long exp) {
    long long result = 1LL;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) {
            result = (result * base) % MOD;
        }
        base = (base * base) % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    long long n, m, l, r;
    cin >> n >> m >> l >> r;
    long long cells = n * m;

    if ((cells & 1) == 1) {
        cout << power(r - l + 1, cells) << endl;
        return 0;
    }

    long long even = r / 2 - (l - 1) / 2;
    long long odd = r - l + 1 - even;

    long long ans = (power(even + odd, cells) + power(even - odd + MOD, cells)) % MOD;
    ans = ans * power(2, MOD - 2) % MOD;

    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
